# Cardano Client Lib

> A Java library for building, signing and submitting Cardano transactions. Latest preview 0.8.0-pre7, Conway era, Java 17+. Latest stable 0.7.3, Java 11+, which doesn't include preview features.

## Pick the right API first

| Task | Use | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| One transaction (send, mint, delegate, vote) | `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.quicktx.QuickTxBuilder` | Default choice. |
| A plan expressed as config rather than code | `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.quicktx.serialization.TxPlan` | YAML/JSON deserializable. |
| Several dependent transactions in order | `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.txflow.exec.FlowEngine` | Handles UTXO chaining and rollback. |
| Continuous submission over time | `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.txflow.stream.TxFlowStream` | Exactly-once, durable restart. |
| Proof an Aiken validator can verify | `com.bloxbean.cardano.vds.mpf.MpfTrie (MPF mode)` | MPF mode only. |

Do NOT generate code against these:

- com.bloxbean.cardano.client.function.* — internal implementation layer
- WatchableQuickTxBuilder — does not exist; superseded by TxFlow

Read https://cardano-client.dev/ai/starter-pack/ before generating code — it lists the mistakes agents
most often make with this library and how to avoid them.

## Learn: a guided path

- [Programmable Tokens with CIP-113](https://cardano-client.dev/learn/cip113-programmable-tokens/): Build a token that can't move without its issuer's approval: register, mint, transfer, seize and burn it on Preview.
- [Minting an NFT](https://cardano-client.dev/learn/minting-an-nft/): Mint a one-of-a-kind token with CIP-25 metadata and a time-locked policy, using QuickTx.
- [Multi-sig transfers](https://cardano-client.dev/learn/multisig/): Example - Multi-signature transfer with native script
- [Native tokens](https://cardano-client.dev/learn/native-tokens/): Create your own token with a native script policy, then send it to several receivers in one transaction.
- [Calling a Plutus script](https://cardano-client.dev/learn/plutus-scripts/): Lock ADA at a Plutus script and unlock it with a redeemer, using QuickTx.
- [Your first transaction](https://cardano-client.dev/learn/simple-transfer/): A simple ada transfer example.
- [Staking & delegation](https://cardano-client.dev/learn/staking-and-delegation/): Register a stake address, delegate to a pool, withdraw rewards and deregister — the full staking lifecycle with QuickTx.
- [Test locally with Yaci DevKit](https://cardano-client.dev/learn/test-with-yaci-devkit/): Run a local Cardano devnet, fund accounts instantly, and move the same code to a public testnet when you're ready.
- [What's next](https://cardano-client.dev/learn/whats-next/): You've finished the guided path. Here's how to choose what to read next based on what you're actually building.

## QuickTx (recommended for single transactions)

- [QuickTx API](https://cardano-client.dev/quicktx/overview/): Declarative transaction building API
- [Unified Tx API](https://cardano-client.dev/quicktx/unified-tx/): ScriptTx merged into Tx — one class for all transaction types

## TxPlan (declarative YAML/JSON plans, preview)

- [TxPlan Advanced Usage](https://cardano-client.dev/txplan/advanced-usage/): Signer Registry, script transactions, multi-tx plans, and dynamic configuration
- [TxPlan: Getting Started](https://cardano-client.dev/txplan/getting-started/): Move a transaction out of Java and into a YAML file you can version, review and reuse — in about ten minutes.
- [TxPlan Overview](https://cardano-client.dev/txplan/overview/): YAML-based transaction definitions with variable substitution

## TxFlow (multi-step workflows, preview)

- [Durable Runtime](https://cardano-client.dev/txflow/durable-runtime/): Persist TxFlow attempts with H2 or PostgreSQL, fenced leases, and explicit recovery
- [Executing Portable Flows](https://cardano-client.dev/txflow/execution-engine/): Parse, preflight, and run portable TxFlow definitions with FlowEngine
- [TxFlow Getting Started](https://cardano-client.dev/txflow/getting-started/): Parse, preflight, and execute a portable TxFlow definition with Java 17
- [Operations and Testing](https://cardano-client.dev/txflow/operations-testing/): Operate, monitor, back up, restore, and verify the durable TxFlow runtime
- [TxFlow Overview](https://cardano-client.dev/txflow/overview/): Portable, policy-controlled Cardano transaction workflow execution
- [Policies, Results, and Observability](https://cardano-client.dev/txflow/policies-results-observability/): Retry, confirmation, rollback, results, cancellation, recovery, and diagnostics for FlowEngine
- [Portable TxFlow Authoring](https://cardano-client.dev/txflow/portable-authoring/): Author safe, reusable TxFlow v1alpha1 YAML and JSON definitions
- [Your first flow](https://cardano-client.dev/txflow/your-first-flow/): Chain two transactions where the second spends what the first produced — the smallest TxFlow that does something you cannot do with QuickTx alone.

## TxStream (continuous submission, preview)

- [TxStream: Durability & Exactly-Once](https://cardano-client.dev/txstream/durability/): Durable store pairing, restart re-attach, dedup scopes, secrets policy, and active/standby HA
- [TxStream Getting Started](https://cardano-client.dev/txstream/getting-started/): Continuous, idempotent transaction submission on the FlowEngine runtime
- [TxStream: Smart Contracts](https://cardano-client.dev/txstream/smart-contracts/): Order-escrow settlement with a real Aiken vault: locking and claiming contract UTXOs through the stream, idempotently, with contract contention serialized on one lane
- [TxStream: Lanes, Batching & Throughput](https://cardano-client.dev/txstream/throughput/): The UTXO concurrency model: lane policies, windows, planners, partitioned fan-out, and honest throughput expectations

## Governance (Conway era)

- [Governance API](https://cardano-client.dev/governance/overview/): APIs for Cardano governance operations (DRep, Voting, Proposals)

## Smart contracts

- [Aiken integration](https://cardano-client.dev/smart-contracts/aiken/): Aiken Integration Apis
- [Annotation processor setup](https://cardano-client.dev/smart-contracts/annotation-processor-setup/): Annotation Processor Dependency
- [Blueprint code generation](https://cardano-client.dev/smart-contracts/blueprint-codegen/): Plutus Blueprint Code Generation
- [Plutus API](https://cardano-client.dev/smart-contracts/plutus-api/): Smart contract interaction with PlutusData, scripts, and blueprints
- [PlutusData annotations](https://cardano-client.dev/smart-contracts/plutusdata-annotations/): Plutus Data Annotations
- [Scalus Integration](https://cardano-client.dev/smart-contracts/scalus/): Evaluate script costs locally and apply script parameters with Scalus.

## Verified structures (preview)

- [Jellyfish Merkle Tree](https://cardano-client.dev/verified-structures/jmt/): Versioned, authenticated off-chain state with inclusion and absence proofs.
- [MpfTrie](https://cardano-client.dev/verified-structures/mpf/): Merkle Patricia Forestry on RocksDB, with proofs that Aiken validators can verify.
- [MPF versions and garbage collection](https://cardano-client.dev/verified-structures/multi-version-gc/): Record versions of an MpfTrie on RocksDB, read old versions and reclaim space.
- [Overview](https://cardano-client.dev/verified-structures/overview/): Merkle Patricia Forestry and Jellyfish Merkle Tree: authenticated data structures for Cardano applications.
- [MPF production guide](https://cardano-client.dev/verified-structures/production-guide/): Atomic writes, RocksDB tuning, thread safety, backup and shutdown for MpfTrie.

## Standards (CIPs)

- [CIP-20 — Transaction messages](https://cardano-client.dev/standards/cip20/): Transaction Message/Comment Metadata implementation
- [CIP-25 — NFT metadata](https://cardano-client.dev/standards/cip25/): NFT Metadata Standard implementation
- [CIP-27 — Royalties](https://cardano-client.dev/standards/cip27/): CNFT Community Royalties Standard implementation
- [CIP-30 — Wallet bridge](https://cardano-client.dev/standards/cip30/): dApp Connector and Data Signing implementation
- [CIP-67 — Asset name labels](https://cardano-client.dev/standards/cip67/): Asset Name Label Registry implementation
- [CIP-68 — Datum metadata](https://cardano-client.dev/standards/cip68/): CIP68 Datum Metadata Api
- [CIP-8 — Message signing](https://cardano-client.dev/standards/cip8/): Message Signing with COSE Signatures implementation

- [Address API](https://cardano-client.dev/reference/address-api/): Address generation, validation, and conversion utilities
- [Backend Services API](https://cardano-client.dev/reference/backend-services/): APIs for integrating with Cardano backend services
- [Coin Selection API](https://cardano-client.dev/reference/coin-selection/): UTXO selection strategies for transaction building
- [Composable Functions API](https://cardano-client.dev/reference/composable-functions/): Flexible transaction building using composable functions
- [Crypto API](https://cardano-client.dev/reference/crypto-api/): Key generation, signing, hashing, and HD derivation utilities
- [HD Wallet API](https://cardano-client.dev/reference/hd-wallet-api/): Hierarchical deterministic wallet management with BIP32/CIP1852 support
- [Metadata API](https://cardano-client.dev/reference/metadata-api/): Transaction metadata creation, management, and serialization
- [Modules & artifacts](https://cardano-client.dev/reference/modules/): Modules and Dependencies
- [Supplier Interfaces API](https://cardano-client.dev/reference/supplier-interfaces/): Extensible interfaces for custom backend data providers

## Modules

All artifacts use group `com.bloxbean.cardano` and version `0.8.0-pre7`.

### recommended

- `cardano-client-address` — Cardano address construction, parsing and derivation. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.address.AddressProvider`
- `cardano-client-metadata` — Transaction auxiliary data and metadata construction. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.metadata.MetadataBuilder`
- `cardano-client-plutus` — Plutus script types, PlutusData encoding and CIP-57 blueprint loading. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.plutus.spec.PlutusData`
- `cardano-client-core` — Account handling and the high-level transaction APIs QuickTx builds on. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.account.Account`
- `cardano-client-quicktx` — Declarative transaction builder. The default way to build any transaction. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.quicktx.QuickTxBuilder`
- `cardano-client-annotation-processor` — Compile-time codegen for PlutusData converters and CIP-57 blueprints. Entry point: `@Constr / @Blueprint annotations`
- `cardano-client-hd-wallet` — HD wallet account and address enumeration over a derivation path. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.wallet.Wallet`
- `cardano-client-governance` — Conway-era governance: DRep registration, voting, committee and treasury actions. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.governance`
- `cardano-client-cip20` — CIP-20 — Transaction message / comment metadata. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.cip.cip20`
- `cardano-client-cip25` — CIP-25 — NFT metadata standard. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.cip.cip25`
- `cardano-client-cip8` — CIP-8 — Message signing (COSE_Sign1). Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.cip.cip8`
- `cardano-client-cip27` — CIP-27 — CNFT community royalties. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.cip.cip27`
- `cardano-client-cip30` — CIP-30 — dApp-wallet web bridge data structures. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.cip.cip30`
- `cardano-client-cip67` — CIP-67 — Asset name label prefixes. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.cip.cip67`
- `cardano-client-cip68` — CIP-68 — Datum metadata standard. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.cip.cip68`
- `cardano-client-cip102` — CIP-102 — Royalty datum standard. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.cip.cip102`
- `cardano-client-backend-blockfrost` — Blockfrost backend implementation. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.backend.blockfrost.service.BFBackendService`
- `cardano-client-backend-koios` — Koios backend implementation. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.backend.koios.KoiosBackendService`
- `cardano-client-backend-ogmios` — Ogmios/Kupo backend implementation. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.backend.ogmios.OgmiosBackendService`
- `cardano-client-backend-nexus` — Nexus backend implementation. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.backend.nexus`
- `cardano-client-plutus-aiken` — Aiken interop: load Aiken blueprints and apply parameters to Aiken-built validators. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.plutus.aiken`

### preview

- `cardano-client-txflow` — Multi-step transaction workflows with dependency tracking, rollback handling and durable restart. Also hosts TxStream for continuous submission. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.txflow.exec.FlowEngine`
- `cardano-client-txflow-store-rdbms` — Relational durable store for TxFlow/TxStream restart recovery. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.txflow.store.rdbms`
- `cardano-client-programmable-token` — Programmable tokens as QuickTx intents, with a CIP-113 adapter: register, mint, transfer, burn and seize. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.programmabletoken.cip113.Cip113ProgrammableTokenService`
- `cardano-client-merkle-patricia-forestry` — Merkle Patricia Forestry trie. In MPF mode this is the Aiken-compatible structure for on-chain proof verification. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.vds.mpf.MpfTrie`
- `cardano-client-jellyfish-merkle` — Jellyfish Merkle Tree for off-chain authenticated state. NOT Aiken-compatible — do not use it for on-chain proof verification. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.vds.jmt.JellyfishMerkleTree`
- `cardano-client-merkle-patricia-forestry-rocksdb` — Embedded RocksDB storage for MpfTrie. Single-process. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.vds.mpf.rocksdb.RocksDbNodeStore`
- `cardano-client-jellyfish-merkle-rocksdb` — Embedded RocksDB storage for the Jellyfish Merkle Tree. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.vds.jmt.rocksdb`
- `cardano-client-merkle-patricia-forestry-rdbms` — Relational storage for MpfTrie (PostgreSQL/H2/SQLite). Multi-process. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.vds.mpf.rdbms`
- `cardano-client-jellyfish-merkle-rdbms` — Relational storage for the Jellyfish Merkle Tree. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.vds.jmt.rdbms`

### advanced

- `cardano-client-function` — Composable TxBuilder primitives. This is the internal implementation layer under QuickTx — use QuickTx unless it genuinely cannot express what you need. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.function.TxBuilder`

### support

- `cardano-client-common` — Shared utilities, network definitions (Networks.mainnet/preprod/preview) and ADA conversion. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.common.model.Networks`
- `cardano-client-crypto` — BIP32-Ed25519, BIP39 mnemonics and CIP-1852 key derivation. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.crypto`
- `cardano-client-common-spec` — Shared CBOR spec types used across transaction and ledger modules. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.spec`
- `cardano-client-transaction-spec` — CDDL-faithful transaction types and CBOR serialization. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.transaction.spec.Transaction`
- `cardano-client-core-api` — Core abstractions: UtxoSupplier, ProtocolParamsSupplier, TransactionProcessor. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.api.UtxoSupplier`
- `cardano-client-coinselection` — UTXO selection strategies. Note the default filters UTXOs carrying a datum hash — that matters when spending script outputs. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.coinselection.UtxoSelectionStrategy`
- `cardano-client-crypto-ext` — Extended cryptographic primitives (BLS12-381, additional hashes). Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.crypto.bls`
- `cardano-client-backend` — Backend service abstraction (UTXO, transaction, epoch, network queries). Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.backend.api.BackendService`
- `cardano-client-supplier-ogmios-supplier` — UtxoSupplier/ProtocolParamsSupplier backed by Ogmios, usable without a full backend. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.supplier.ogmios`
- `cardano-client-supplier-kupo-supplier` — UtxoSupplier backed by Kupo. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.client.supplier.kupo`
- `cardano-client-verified-structures-core` — Shared node-store and proof abstractions for the verified data structures. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.vds.core`
- `cardano-client-rocksdb-core` — RocksDB node-store shared by the embedded trie backends. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.vds.rocksdb`
- `cardano-client-rdbms-core` — JDBC node-store shared by the relational trie backends. Entry point: `com.bloxbean.cardano.vds.rdbms`
